lightning.line: And if I were like lightning
stanza: And if I were like lightning
Well, I'd come and go wherever I would please
And I'd scare 'em by the shade tree
And scare 'em by the light pole
But I would not scare my pony on my boat out on the sea

lightning.line: And then my fingers turned to lightning
stanza: So I hit a couple of cords
In my old country way of strumming
And then my fingers turned to lightning
Man, I never heard it coming
It was like I always knew it
I just don't know where I learned it
It wasn't nothin' but the truth
So I just reared back and burned it
Sleeping children better run like the wind
Mama's little baby better get herself in
